notes.title: A bunch of fixes and improvements
notes.content:
Removed text about destroying everything

Made it so all except first contamination road block are able to pass through without breaking stuff

Changed computer text on starting computer to not incentivize destroying the terrain.

[b]Thought: After reading szederpg’s review I decided to dial back to destroying the environment for supplies, they brought up a good point that it feels like mashing the “use” button to find a secret door. Instead ammo boxes and backpacks will be found around. You can still destroy terrain, it will still give you items, but you don’t have to go around hitting everything in hope of getting ammo or hp.[/b]

Covered up tool box that I original made give ammo as an Easter egg because it comes off more as a glitch, the truth is the tool box is baked into the environment.

[b]Changed position of dialogue text, increased font size[/b]

Added new destroy-able item Locker to find ammo

Reduced decay time of bodies from 25 to 10

Some optimizing of zombies (to increase FPS)

Changing to last computer text

[b]Increased zombie head hit box (this should make less missing or feels bad with the pipe)[/b]

Added puss volumetric effect to bloat flies

Non breakable glass will no longer shatter when hit

Fixed issue where key card from body option wouldn’t disappear when taken


In the works:
Physics based hit reaction system for monsters
Toggle “e” to hold objects instead of hold

Increased zombie head hit box (this should make less missing or feels bad with the pipe)

notes.title: "Blood and Immersion" Update is live
notes.content:
[b]All levels[/b]
Volumetric blood (blood that sprays out and lands on objects)
Added environmental story telling
Blood just like... everywhere.
Backpacks and boxes! New breakable objects giving small amount of of health and ammo.

[b]The idea was for this patch to tone back the amount of health from medical boxes, and the amount of ammo from ammo clips, and make the player "live off the land" I think this feels way more true to my original vision.[/b]

reworked visual effects
reworked textures

body decay set to 30 seconds
bodies no longer trip up or stop the players movement
